title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - B-23
notes:
West appears to have found a good lead by attacking hearts. South must lose tricks to the ♠A and ♣A. South must find a way to dispose of 1 of his 2 heart losers. The diamond suit is blocked and the ♥A is the only entry to the dummy.

If South wins the ♥A and concedes a heart trick to the defense, they will play ♠A and another spade. Dummy's trumps will be drawn and South will be left with another heart loser.

If South ducks in dummy at trick 1, the defense is placed in a dilemma. If hearts are continued, South will be able to cross to the ♦A and ruff his remaining heart in the dummy. If the defense plays 2 rounds of trump, South can draw the last trump, unblock the ♦A, and cross to the ♥A to run the diamonds.
